synth.readme:
# AudioKit Synth One

We've open-sourced the code for this synthesizer so everyone can make changes, introduce features and fix bugs. Synth One is Universal for iPhone/iPad.

Many features are available as modules in AudioKit, including oscillators, filters, reverbs, effects and other audio processing.

## Features & App Store Location

- [AudioKit Synth One Features](https://audiokitpro.com/synth)
- [Download in App Store](http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/audiokit-synth-one-synthesizer/id1371050497)

## Link Installation

The repository builds and runs without modification, but the Link functionality will be missing unless extra SDK files are supplied.

## Opportunities for Contributing

- Ability to search presets
- MIDI Learn Matrix
- Add an EQ Panel

✓ DONE: Create an iPhone/Universal version.
✓ DONE: Add accessibility functionality.

There are a few major updates we intend for this synth:

- AUV3 Plugin support
- MPE

## Code Usage

You are free to use this code as a learning tool, change it, build a larger app and contribute code back. Musicians can use the app and developers with audio experience can contribute.

# Artificial Intelligence for Beginners - A Curriculum

Explore Artificial Intelligence with our 12-week, 24-lesson curriculum. It includes practical lessons, quizzes and labs. The curriculum is beginner-friendly.

## Multi-Language Support

Translations are available in many languages.

## What you will learn

- Symbolic AI and knowledge representation
- Neural Networks and Deep Learning
- Computer Vision
- Genetic Algorithms and Multi-Agent Systems

## What we will not cover in this curriculum

- Business cases of using AI
- Classic Machine Learning
- Conversational AI and chat bots
- Deep Mathematics behind deep learning

- [Neural Networks Notebook](./lessons/3-NeuralNetworks/README.md)
